title: Network dynamics of positive and negative affect in bipolar disorder
sample_size: 32 adults with bipolar I disorder and 36 healthy control participants
limitations: - The network analyses assume stationarity. - Ratings of affect were collected once per day, which may not capture momentary experiences. - Participants were required to maintain inter-episode status, precluding examination of predictors of episode relapse.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. The authors state that supplementary materials are available online at the provided DOI, but do not specify if code or data are publicly available. The paper was published in 2019, and no pre-registration link was found.
